title: why did I leave ohio? so I could watch every single @New York City Ce...
transcript: my claim to fame is that I am the world's biggest New York City Center fan look I even have my own little billboard to prove it it's my face right there and New York City Center encores might be my favorite thing in the city I was very excited to see Wonderful Town also to check out their new neighbor the Backstage Speakeasy which is inside the Stage Star Deli this place is so cool anyway New York City Center hosted an event there before the show it was really fun and we even got to hear from the director Zhailon Levingston who I just think is like so brilliant it was also just a room of like Peak Theater kids you have to hear the reaction when Zhailon mentioned there was going to be tap was a tap component *shock & awe!* I love us so much anyway we then headed over to the theater where they gave me a front row seat and I was losing it this was the invited dress so they had some speeches before the show this is Michael he's the president and CEO of New York City Center every time I see him I beg him to bring back encores! off-center we got to hear from Lear DeBessonet because this is her final show before she goes to Lincoln Center in the fall I can't believe Ragtime's coming to Broadway and then it was time for the show goodness I really had a fun time don't get me wrong I love when City Center does like an into the Woods or a parade but like my favorite encores is when they do a weird little musical and Wonderful Town fit the Bill in every single way it's the story of two sisters from Ohio who come to New York to make their dreams come true one wants to be a writer one wants to be an actress a lot of silly goofy things happen and there's great music super fun choreography the sisters are played by Anika Noni Rose and Aisha Jackson who are both so incredible Aisha has one of my absolute favorite voices and Anika was literally a Disney princess Javier Muñoz and Fergie Philippe were also delightful in it I don't think I stopped smiling for one single second it’s only playing through this weekend I should have made this video earlier but go and see it I promise you have so much fun and honestly it is worth just getting to hear that score with this orchestra you can't miss it congrats on an incredible season New York City center
classificationReason: Creator attended the invited dress of 'Wonderful Town' at NY City Center Encores and describes the experience (front row seat, speeches, etc.). 'Wonderful Town' is not on the provided list. Ragtime is mentioned only in passing at the very end.
